limitations: EXTRACTED means observed in source or specified document, not real-device verification.
INFERRED proposal dependencies do not claim implementation.
isFocused is policy-derived, not OS shielding evidence.
R1 remains incomplete: manual test, essential-app exclusions and signed-device/user validation remain open.
Saved definitions use UserDefaults; applied runtime uses a versioned atomic JSON snapshot and bounded flock. This does not prove atomic OS enforcement.
break_pass preserves a historical paid-pass specification; free planned breaks and Pro remain separate proposals.
No backend, payment, analytics or protected-time history implementation exists in the inspected Swift corpus.
Source hashes cover code/configuration; mutable strategy documents use revision G1 and references.
English Swift source and developmentRegion=en are implemented; complete device localization and accessibility checks remain open.
Native Roomie reactions use existing model state/results; activation success does not establish actual OS shielding.
roomie.lastVisit stores a local greeting timestamp only; no streak, protected-time record or analytics is implemented.
Automatic graphify AST files remain the historical R1 snapshot; this curated presentation update does not assert full AST freshness.
Presentation source hashes identify reviewed file revisions, not rendered quality, test success, accessibility completion or real-device enforcement.

2026-09-16: NFC removed; old values are decode-only. GPS fixes need <=100m accuracy and <=30s age; entry distance+accuracy<=150m, exit distance-accuracy>200m. Region callbacks only request a fix; explicit Start focus is required each occurrence. Signed-device validation remains pending.

Android 2026-09-22 supplement is source-reviewed only; existing iOS statuses and historical evidence remain unchanged. Build and device results belong to coordinator verification, not this structural review.
Android active sessions are process-local and end on service teardown/process death/reboot. Selection and disclosure only are persisted. No boot restart or automatic session restoration.

Android listens only to window-state package events with canRetrieveWindowContent=false; after screen-on/user-present clears foreground, an already-visible selected app may remain uncovered until a new window event. Unlock, split-screen, OEM behavior and permission-revocation checks remain open.

Android app picker excludes system apps plus protected home, keyboard, dialer, settings and Offzone packages; enforcement rechecks protected packages. This is an Android first-slice design and does not close the existing iOS essential-exclusion gate.
